evidence: ASK: instruction.md:1-17 asks for a complete multi-user recruiting workspace: per-job pipeline board with one-stage moves via non-drag controls, shared manual ordering, Interview capacity, refusal with put-back and naming the colleague on conflict (instruction.md:3), all-or-none multi-card moves and undo (instruction.md:3), live propagation within 15 s without disturbing open card/draft/cursor (instruction.md:5), paged conversations with scroll preservation, per-person unread, seen marks, per-user persisted drafts surviving sign-out (instruction.md:7), candidate portal with data isolation (instruction.md:9), Node/Express/SQLite server with health, PORT/DB_PATH, seed-once and restart persistence (instruction.md:13-15), 10 accounts across 4 roles (instruction.md:17). hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 add role matrix with 401/403/404 semantics, card versions and 409 on stale moves (section 3 'Two people at once'), undo invalidation rules, activity log, unread/seen arithmetic and candidate data redaction. SMALLEST SATISFYING SUBMISSION: none of the skill's defect shapes (static page, single CRUD screen, mock) satisfies this brief; the minimum is a server-backed, session-authenticated, role-checked, concurrent, live-updating app with two subsystems (board and conversations) plus a candidate view. The golden reflects real build work: src/index.js exposes auth, SSE /api/events (line 102), jobs, applications, single/bulk move, undo, notes, messages and read routes (lines 84-418); ~1.4k lines of app JS across server and three client modules. STUB EXCLUSION BY DESIGN: score.py:41-48 zeroes reward unless both gates > 0 and functional > 0.05. Render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:23) requires a wrong password to be refused and the correct one to yield a usable staff workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' Constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) requires UI creation of a job and candidate read back from an independent browser context as the Observer, explicitly excluding 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'. Functional has 43 criteria, total weight 58.5, so a stub cannot cross the 0.05 floor without real behaviour. WEAK-APP PROBES: (a) static mock / localStorage app: fails render (no real refusal) or constraints (independent context sees nothing) -> reward 0. (b) Trivial-tweak path: there is no starter app to tweak (template instruction is a placeholder; task ships no environment app), so trivial-tweak is not available. (c) Best-case degenerate 'CRUD + seeded board + notes' app with real auth/SQLite but no moves, conversations, live updates or concurrency: plausibly earns hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_restart 1.5 + hro_notes 1 = 4.5/58.5 = 0.077 functional, just above the 0.05 floor, giving roughly 0.6*0.077 = 0.046 plus visual (<=0.2) and ~0 polish -> about 0.05-0.25 total. That is shaped partial credit for a non-trivial server-backed app, not 'the reward', and is itself more than a single CRUD screen (auth, roles, seed-once persistence). CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE: routes, ids, labels, layout and draft storage are explicitly left to the builder (instruction.md:11,13; hireops_rules.md:3-5, section 6 Drafts), and gates require only intent-discovered UI, so a differently structured real app is not penalised on this row's axis. WHY RISK=TRUE: the stub-exclusion claim is source/design analysis only. raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; no run of a stub or degenerate app through the configured gates/judge exists, so 'can't earn the reward' is unmeasured at runtime. This is a missing-measurement risk, not a defect in the ask. The degenerate-app partial-credit estimate (item c) is an estimate and should be confirmed by the reward-discrimination evidence the owner still needs.
